description: This module developed by IIASA extends MESSAGEix-GLOBIOM with water demand, water availability and infrastructure linked to energy and land use. It builds basin structures, cooling technologies, irrigation demands and other water-sector parameters on a supplied model scenario. The current documentation names the resulting model MESSAGEix-Nexus and provides Python and command-line workflows. Spatial coverage can be global or a configured country, with basin boundaries intersected with model regions. Annual or subannual water time steps depend on prepared inputs and model sets. Public code and the paper-linked Zenodo archive are free under Apache-2.0. The module supports least-cost infrastructure scenarios and examination of water constraints on energy choices. A limitation is that it requires a compatible base scenario and prepared data; the documentation identifies changes to required solar-technology names across package versions. Existing model-messageix-framework is the underlying optimization framework. The module was not solved, and archive files were not downloaded.
inputs: Water demands, cooling and infrastructure assumptions
